description: This file defines the Git::IndexInfo class, providing methods to manipulate and output Git index entries, including adding, removing, and updating entries, as well as managing associated resources and configuration settings.

classes.name: Git::IndexInfo
classes.description: A class representing Git index information, enabling modification and output of index entries.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new IndexInfo object, setting up communication pipes and config.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an index entry by path, writing the removal information to the pipe.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Adds or updates an index entry with mode, hash, and path information.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor that closes the communication pipe.
